title: The PTM Code of Fibrosis: A Qualitative Review of Post-Translational Regulation in Pathological Tissue Remodeling

contributions.purpose: 整合梳理翻译后修饰(PTM)如何调控纤维化核心信号通路
contributions.mechanism: 综述磷酸化/泛素化/乙酰化/SUMO 化/糖基化等主要 PTM 对 TGF-β/Smad、Wnt、JAK/STAT3、Rho/ROCK 轴的'writer-eraser-reader'调控
contributions.evaluation: 定性文献综述,无原始数据/量化指标;以 Table 1 汇总各 PTM-酶-靶蛋白-通路-功能对应关系
contributions.domain: 纤维化分子生物学/PTM 蛋白质组
contributions.source_quote: This qualitative literature review provides an in-depth analysis of the correlation between fibrotic mechanisms and PTMs, offering an integrated perspective on how PTMs exquisitely control key fibrosis-related signaling pathways.

contributions.purpose: 比较 PTM-纤维化机制在不同器官的共性与特异性
contributions.mechanism: 跨器官对比:心(激酶/HDAC 平衡)、肝(泛素-蛋白酶体系统)、肾(乙酰化-磷酸化 tandem)、肺(糖基化与 ECM 微环境)
contributions.evaluation: 定性;举例如肾纤维化中 DUSP1 去乙酰化→表达下降→Smad3 持续磷酸化(引 Sun 2025 等一手文献)
contributions.source_quote: this review compares and analyzes the commonalities and specificities of PTM regulatory mechanisms in fibrosis across major organs like the heart, liver, kidney, and lung.

contributions.purpose: 提出把 PTM 串扰视为纤维化的'生物语言语法'并指向精准治疗
contributions.mechanism: 将 PTM crosstalk(如乙酰化为磷酸化的先决条件 tandem code)概念化为'syntax',并倡导 PTM proteomics/'PTM-ome' 系统分析与靶向 PTM 酶(kinase/HDAC/HAT/E3)的抗纤维化策略
contributions.evaluation: 定性/思辨;列举 A-485、MLN4924、ginkgolic acid 等在研抑制剂,但均引用他人研究,本文无实验验证
contributions.source_quote: It also explores how PTM crosstalk, such as the tandem activation of acetylation and phosphorylation, functions as the 'grammar' of a complex biological language.

notes: reject。非实证的定性文献综述,协议适配:无实验/无数据划分,evaluation 全为定性(Paper Checklist 第 3-8 项多为 NA)。AI 自我披露极强且关键:整篇综述由两个 LLM agent 自主协作生成——Gemini 出初稿、ChatGPT 做类同行评审、AI-AI 迭代至收敛,人类仅定选题/格式(第 2 节明言'intentionally minimized human intellectual input');AI Involvement Checklist 写作项为 D(AI 完成 >95% 写作),分析项 C。最重大风险(Observed AI Limitations 自承):主 AI 倾向生成'hallucinated/non-existent references',需靠另一 AI 做验证——对一篇价值全在引文的综述而言,引用真实性存疑是致命隐患。无 self-declared provenance(extend/adapt/replace 式表述)。无编号贡献列表,由 abstract 归纳。
